reference_evidence_units.quote: In low-polarity solvents, PRA-3HC predominantly adopts the N1-H(a) form, yielding efficient ESIPT emission with fluorescence quantum yields of 65%–66%.
reference_evidence_units.subject: PRA-3HC
reference_evidence_units.statement: Efficient ESIPT (tautomer) emission from the N1-H(a) isomer.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Increased solvent polarity shifts the ground-state equilibrium toward the non-emissive N2-H(b) isomer with nπ* transition
reference_evidence_units.subject: PRA-3HC
reference_evidence_units.statement: In polar solvents a non-emissive isomer with an nπ* lowest state dominates.

reference_evidence_units.quote: spectroscopic studies further demonstrate that only the N1-H(a) isomer undergoes efficient ESIPT and contributes to the tautomer emission
reference_evidence_units.subject: PRA-3HC
reference_evidence_units.statement: Only one ground-state isomer undergoes efficient ESIPT.

reference_evidence_units.quote: whereas that of N2-H(b) contains substantial nπ* character

reference_evidence_units.statement: The non-emissive isomer has an nπ*-dominated S1.
